raw_response: {"diagnosis": "80 raw_transactions rows are in EUR, but silver_transactions passes amount through without converting it, so gold USD totals mix EUR and USD values. raw_fx_rates has a rate_to_usd for EUR (1.25) and USD (1.0), so amounts can be converted to USD in the silver step.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * fx.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates fx ON fx.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
